description.tr: Edebiyat alimi, İsfahanlılardan, Bağdat'ta oturdu ve son günlerinde Irak'ta kendisine eşi yoktu.
description.en: A scholar of literature, from the people of Isfahan, who settled in Baghdad and had no equal in Iraq
